set.body:
Type: implementation task
Work key: CX03
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: Folders do not indicate findings inside them; only the file row carries a count, so problems are invisible until every folder is opened.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Collapsed folders show an aggregate badge by highest severity (error/warning) with the count; badges have text equivalents.
2. A "Files with findings" filter narrows the tree to affected files and their folders, combined with the text filter.
3. Selecting a finding's path anywhere opens and reveals it in the tree.

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console.sh` (new guarded probes, current source 0 failures) and, where noted, `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js (tree rendering)
set.title: CX03: Surface findings in the file tree
